entities.name: PMID:27506730
observations: A 2016 human MRS study measured abdominal DSAT and SSAT fatty-acid unsaturation and IMCL in 16 healthy BMI-discordant monozygotic twin pairs; DSAT unsaturation inversely correlated with IMCL (R = -0.462, P = 0.001).
The inverse DSAT-unsaturation/IMCL association replicated in 12 healthy volunteers (R = -0.641, P = 0.025); no adjusted effect or species-level estimate was reported.

entities.name: PMID:10426379
observations: A study of 14 lean offspring of people with type 2 diabetes and 14 controls found elevated soleus IMTG in offspring, but normal calf subcutaneous-fat saturated/unsaturated carbon content; it reported no direct association and did not study a deep abdominal depot.

entities.name: DSAT unsaturation inverse IMCL
observations: Human MRS evidence supports an inverse association between deep abdominal subcutaneous-fat unsaturation and IMCL: R = -0.462 (P = 0.001) in 16 BMI-discordant twin pairs, replicated at R = -0.641 (P = 0.025) in 12 volunteers; causality and generalizability remain unestablished.
